description: This file defines an immutable class `ImmutableSortOptionEntry` implementing the `SortOptionEntry` interface, representing sorting options with a property path and order.

classes.name: ImmutableSortOptionEntry
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the `SortOptionEntry` interface, providing static factory methods for creation and methods to access its properties.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an `ImmutableSortOptionEntry` with specified property path and order.

methods.name: asc
methods.description: Static factory method to create an ascending sort option for the given property path.

methods.name: desc
methods.description: Static factory method to create a descending sort option for the given property path.

methods.name: getPropertyPath
methods.description: Returns the property path of the sort option.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order (ascending or descending).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the sort option.
